gen-gf-noto-nastaliq-urdu-archivo: Classic Noto Nastaliq Urdu keeps small letters almost cap-high, thins still sturdy, thicks still restrained. Archivo answers with outward-opening curves, so serif and sans-serif share the sheet.
gen-gf-noto-nastaliq-urdu-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans is a contrast-free sans-serif under classic Noto Nastaliq Urdu. The hook is sturdy, restrained serif stress against Fira Sans bowls that never swell, a large x-height on a level line.
gen-gf-noto-nastaliq-urdu-general-sans: General Sans reads clean, a steady pen and a full x-height under dignified Noto Nastaliq Urdu. General Sans keeps copy moving on unobstructed bends, a plain sans under that restrained serif.
gen-gf-noto-nastaliq-urdu-montserrat: Restrained serif stress over geometric wire: Noto Nastaliq Urdu against Montserrat. Montserrat glides on one gauge with oversized counters, so heading and a plain sans share the sheet.
gen-gf-noto-nastaliq-urdu-work-sans: Small letters almost cap-high mark Noto Nastaliq Urdu, thins still sturdy, thicks still restrained. Work Sans answers with matching joins, so heading and sans-serif share the sheet.
gen-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew-archivo: Archivo reads editorial, curves opening outward, a commanding x-height under Noto Rashi Hebrew. Archivo keeps copy moving on that large x-height, a sans under the bookish, slightly thinner hairlines.
gen-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads approachable, unclamped curves under bookish Noto Rashi Hebrew. Epilogue keeps copy moving on a one-nib line, stubby extenders and a hefty lowercase under those mellow serif hairlines.
gen-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans is a contrast-free sans-serif under Noto Rashi Hebrew, wide s turns and a large x-height. Fira Sans keeps copy moving without any swell or thin as you go.
gen-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew-general-sans: Noto Rashi Hebrew is a bookish serif, slightly thinner hairlines in a dense lowercase band. General Sans does the long stretch on a steady pen; the heading does the literary short line.
gen-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew-manrope: Noto Rashi Hebrew is a bookish serif, a soft cadence of fuller stems and slimmer links. And Manrope holds one width through every mouth, so heading and sans-serif share the sheet.
gen-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew-montserrat: Noto Rashi Hebrew is a bookish serif, slightly thinner hairlines in a dense lowercase band. And Noto Rashi Hebrew wants a few large words, while Montserrat does the long stretch on geometric wire.
gen-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew-satoshi: Slightly thinner hairlines in a dense lowercase band mark Noto Rashi Hebrew. Satoshi keeps copy moving on a soaring x-height and a wide-open e, a plain sans under that modest brass-like stress.
gen-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew-switzer: Noto Rashi Hebrew is a bookish serif, slightly thinner hairlines in a dense lowercase band over Switzer. Drop the copy a notch; it still reads on those tubular Swiss letters.
gen-gf-noto-sans-adlam-fs-erode: Erode sits editorial under Noto Sans Adlam, a gentle ebb of weight and a broad g against a generous e. Erode keeps copy moving through dense text without catching.
gen-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoined-fs-erode: Erode sits editorial under Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined, wide mouths on outsized lowercase. Erode loses some dignity if the heading shrinks, and takes over if the copy grows.
